content.title: Chuck Norris Estate
content.text: Lauren Santa Ana, California About This Space This charming private estate in North Tustin was owned by actor and martial arts pro Chuck Norris in the 1980s and later sold to Tiffany the recording artist. The house and guest house, with a total of 5,500-square-feet of living space, are reached by descending a steep, private gated driveway to a lush, nearly two-acre parcel. It’s a magical enchanted property with beautiful lush trees, a koi filled lake with an charming dock to entertain on. Features Don’t see the features you’re looking for?
